findings.desc: CHK-002:edge:0 is marked covered in checklist evidence (.koala/story/actives/B-bffc/checklist.json:131-179), but the referenced smoke test does not assert the claimed visible optional-provider degradations. packages/main/src/tasks/lattice-cli-migration-smoke.ts:101-117 only checks schema/version/macAppRequired and host/prod flags for host_list/host_probe; it never inspects probe.degradations, visible degradation fields, or any non-fatal conditional capability output even though the Codex host profile exposes those degradations in packages/main/src/core/capabilities.ts:207-214. As written, the test can pass even if missing optional providers stop being reported as visible degradations, so this must intent is not actually covered.

CHK-003:edge:0 and CHK-005:edge:0 are both recorded as covered (.koala/story/actives/B-bffc/checklist.json:221-255 and :387-423; .koala/story/actives/B-bffc/test-evidence.json:3-4), but the smoke file never asserts the missing-authority-URL fallback contract it claims to cover. packages/main/src/tasks/lattice-cli-migration-smoke.ts:135-141 only checks generic receipt/production false flags plus /no receipt is verified/ in note. The actual fallback surface is in packages/main/src/handlers/lattice-cli.ts:119-135: baseURLConfigured=false, baseURL=null, and status=not-configured when no authority URL exists. Because none of those fields are asserted, the test can pass even if missing-authority fallback guidance regresses while validate still reports 15/15 covered.
